stem: Jatin measures a strip of tape as $4$ tenths of a metre on a scale marked in tenths and hundredths.

parts.text: Which claim correctly renames that length using hundredths?

options.text: The length is $4$ hundredths of a metre.
The length is $40$ hundredths of a metre.
The length is $4$ metres, because the digit $4$ is the clearest mark on the scale.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

part_answers.answer: Ten hundredths make one tenth, so $4$ tenths equal $40$ hundredths of a metre.

teacher.key_rationale: Place value links tenths to hundredths by tens: $4$ tenths = $40$ hundredths. Naming $4$ hundredths swaps the place; grabbing the digit $4$ as metres is surface only.
